Preserve the optional dangerous arena, the actual possibility of petrification or egg loss, and Vaurach's overwhelming presence. Clear warnings and alternate approaches do not promise painless success.

synthesis.agreement: Second full editorial pass remains clean across all five lenses. Captured Cael stays out of later scenes; his unknown motive remains learnable from the hatchery. Declining companions and arena gifts leaves guides, waymarks, bridge/ridge routes and ordinary basilisk counters. Missing, cracked and destroyed eggs have distinct outcomes; Ilsabet remains free and failed negotiations can close honestly.
dissent: Nan is a poorer fit for deadly fairy-tale adventure; this is not a defect vote.
Bert values reliable relics but cannot demand a numerical economy contrary to the declared story.
Ines values NPC refusal; Gerry values closure. Neither requires effortless peace or compulsory persuasion success.
synthesis.limits: These are textual contingency checks, not gameplay execution. Actual dialogue, hazard adjudication, reward persistence, audio comprehension and pace remain untested. No further edits are justified solely by the iteration count.
